verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides a REST API for registrar operations (search, register, manage domains) and Cloudflare documents an official MCP server for its developer platform, suggesting domains could be managed via AI agents/natural-language tooling, but there is no direct evidence that the MCP server exposes registrar-specific actions or that any natural-language interface has been used to buy/renew/manage domains. missing for 10: explicit MCP/agent tool coverage of Registrar operations, hands-on evidence of natural-language domain management, first-party docs tying Registrar to AI agent workflows.
